scripts.build: npm run build -w @gienharness/domain && npm run build -w @gienharness/infrastructure && npm run build -w @gienharness/api --if-present && npm run build -w @gienharness/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gienharness/domain && npm run build -w @gienharness/infrastructure && npm run typecheck -w @gienharness/domain -w @gienharness/infrastructure -w @gienharness/api -w @gienharness/web --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @gienharness/domain && npm run build -w @gienharness/infrastructure && npm run dev -w @gienharness/api
